g.text: log.info("{}: ProducerRunnable is exiting. messagesSent={}; uniqueMessagesSent={}; "+"ackedSends={}/{}.",id,messagesSent,uniqueMessagesSent,spec.maxMessages()-unackedSends,spec.maxMessages())
